```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", dpi=5000, fig.height = 3.25, fig.width = 7.5,  fig.cap= ""}
library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(glmmTMB)

# Load models
fit_SES_pdi <- readRDS("../Data/fit_SES_pdi_over1.rds")
fit_SES_nd  <- readRDS("../Data/fit_SES_nd_over1.rds")
fit_SES_mh  <- readRDS("../Data/fit_SES_mh_over1.rds")

# Base theme
base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 7.5) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.3),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Colours
my_cols <- c(
  "#6B5C5C",  # Bees
  "#E68A00",  # Coleo.
  "#009E73",  # Hymen.
  "#0072B2",  # Lepid.
  "#4FBFB6",  # Non-syr.
  "#C05A93"   # Syrph.
)


# Linetypes
my_lty <- c(
  "solid",
  "dashed",
  "dotdash",
  "longdash",
  "twodash",
  "dotted"
)

# Marginal effects
gp_mh  <- ggpredict(fit_SES_mh,  terms = c("Dominance[all]", "Group"), type = "fixed")
gp_pdi <- ggpredict(fit_SES_pdi, terms = c("Dominance[all]", "Group"), type = "fixed")
gp_nd  <- ggpredict(fit_SES_nd,  terms = c("Dominance[all]", "Group"), type = "fixed")

group_breaks <- c("Bees", "Coleo.", "Hymen.", "Lepid.", "Non-syr.", "Syrph.")

group_labels <- c(
  "Bees" = "Bees",
  "Coleo." = "Coleoptera",
  "Hymen." = "Non-bee Hymenoptera",
  "Lepid." = "Lepidoptera",
  "Non-syr." = "Non-syrphid Diptera",
  "Syrph." = "Syrphidae"
)

my_cols <- setNames(my_cols, group_breaks)
my_lty  <- setNames(my_lty, group_breaks)

# Plots
mh <- plot(gp_mh) +
  aes(linetype = group) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = my_cols,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = my_cols,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = my_lty,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "SES of Resource Overlap",
    color = "Group",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none",
    colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA)),
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  ) +
  ggtitle("")

pdi <- plot(gp_pdi) +
  aes(linetype = group) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = my_cols,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = my_cols,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = my_lty,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Honeybee Dominance (ln-ratio)",
    y = "SES of Specialisation",
    color = "Group",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none",
    colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA)),
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  ) +
  ggtitle("")

nd <- plot(gp_nd) +
  aes(linetype = group) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = my_cols,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = my_cols,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = my_lty,
    breaks = group_breaks,
    labels = group_labels[group_breaks]
  )+
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "SES of Normalised Degree",
    color = "Group",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none",
    colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA)),
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  ) +
  ggtitle("")

# Helper: change ribbon alpha only
set_ribbon_alpha <- function(p, alpha = 0.08) {
  for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
    if (inherits(p$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomRibbon")) {
      p$layers[[i]]$aes_params$alpha <- alpha
    }
  }
  p
}

set_linewidth <- function(p, lw = 0.7) {
  for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
    if (inherits(p$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomLine")) {
      p$layers[[i]]$aes_params$linewidth <- lw
    }
  }
  p
}

mh  <- set_linewidth(mh,  0.9)
pdi <- set_linewidth(pdi, 0.9)
nd  <- set_linewidth(nd,  0.9)

bring_lines_after <- function(p) {
  ribbon_idx <- which(sapply(p$layers, function(x) inherits(x$geom, "GeomRibbon")))
  line_idx   <- which(sapply(p$layers, function(x) inherits(x$geom, "GeomLine")))
  other_idx  <- setdiff(seq_along(p$layers), c(ribbon_idx, line_idx))
  
  p$layers <- c(p$layers[ribbon_idx], p$layers[line_idx], p$layers[other_idx])
  p
}

mh  <- set_ribbon_alpha(mh,  alpha = 0.07)
pdi <- set_ribbon_alpha(pdi, alpha = 0.07)
nd  <- set_ribbon_alpha(nd,  alpha = 0.07)

mh  <- bring_lines_after(mh)
pdi <- bring_lines_after(pdi)
nd  <- bring_lines_after(nd)

# Combine and apply theme
p <- (mh | pdi | nd) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, nrow = 1, guides = "collect") &
  base_theme &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.1, "lines"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = -1, b = 0, unit = "pt"), 
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(0, 2.5, 2, 0), "pt"),
    plot.tag = element_text(size= 14, face = "bold", vjust = 0.35),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.25, "cm")
  )

p + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_suffix = ")") &
  guides(
    colour   = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(fill = NA)),
    linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  )

```
